sources.quote: Founded October 28, 2021; Headquarters: Seoul, South Korea (용산구 한강대로 109); Black Pearl Proptech Fund I & II (May 27, 2022); CEO: Kim Hyoseop (김효섭); 4 employees

sources.title: 신생 블랙펄벤처스, 직방 350억 투자 '눈길'
sources.supports: Zigbang secondary investment of ~35 billion won; cumulative AUM ~46 billion won within a year; founders' backgrounds; RIDI and Greenlabs investments
sources.quote: 블랙펄벤처스는 최근 350억원 규모로 직방 구주를 인수했습니다. 이번 직방 투자로 일년 만에 460억원의 누적운용자산(AUM)을 확보했습니다. ... 콘텐츠 플랫폼 스타트업 리디와 에그테크 스타트업 그린랩스에 각각 50억원, 60억원을 투자했습니다.

sources.title: 부동산 투자의 필수 '프롭테크' - 한경부동산밸류업센터
sources.supports: Zigbang raised 100억원 and 350억원 from Shinhan Venture Investment and Black Pearl Ventures in June 2022; Zigbang valued at 2.5 trillion won; first proptech unicorn
sources.quote: 직방은 2022년 6월에 신한벤처투자, 블랙펄벤처스로부터 100억원 및 350억원을 투자 유치했습니다. 직방의 기업가치는 2조5,000억원으로 평가받았으며, 프롭테크 분야 최초 유니콘 기업입니다.

verification_notes: Korean-language press reports the Zigbang deal as '350억원' (35 billion KRW) for a secondary stake; an English machine translation rendered this as '350 billion won', which is incorrect — the won figure is 35 billion KRW (~US$27M). AUM '460억원' = 46 billion KRW. Fund sizes for individual proptech funds not disclosed (null). USD conversions left null to avoid fabricated rates.

strategy.thesis: Global early-stage corporate venture arm of GS Group investing across Built Environment & Construction tech, Physical AI & Robotics, Energy & Industrial Transition, and Digital Platforms — explicitly targeting technologies that modernize how the world designs, builds, and operates real assets, with strategic synergy to GS E&C.

application.how_to_apply: Inbound via firm website; deal flow through GS Group strategic interests and US/Korea venture networks.

summary.en: GS Futures is the global early-stage corporate venture arm of South Korea's GS Group, established in 2020 with a California base and Korean ties to GS E&C. It invests across four themes — Built Environment & Construction, Physical AI & Robotics, Energy & Industrial Transition, and Digital Platforms — backing construction-tech and proptech companies such as Clearstory, Butlr and construction-site robot maker August Robotics, with strategic synergy to GS Group's construction and energy businesses.
summary.local: 지에스퓨처스(GS Futures)는 GS그룹의 글로벌 초기단계 기업주도형 벤처캐피탈(CVC)로 2020년 설립됐다. 미국(캘리포니아)에 기반을 두면서 GS건설과 연계해 '건설·부동산테크(Built Environment & Construction)', '피지컬 AI·로보틱스', '에너지·산업 전환', '디지털 플랫폼' 등 4개 분야에 투자한다. 건설현장 자율주행 로봇 스타트업 어거스트로보틱스 등 콘테크·프롭테크 기업에 투자해 왔다.

verification_notes: GS Futures is the global (US-based, California) CVC arm of GS Group, distinct from GS Ventures and from GS E&C's domestic CVC XPLOR Investment. Classified region=south-korea (GS Group parent) per task scoping, country='South Korea' for the parent group though primary office is in California. Fund sizes, AUM, and check sizes not publicly disclosed (null). Some portfolio companies (e.g., August Robotics, Clearstory, Butlr) are construction/proptech-relevant; full portfolio also spans energy, biotech and consumer.
